title: **Iran’s Teenage Volleyball Heroes Salute the World After Clinching Gold**
text:
**Iran’s Teenage Volleyball Heroes Salute the World After Clinching Gold**"

""
"Following their stunning triumph at the World Championship, Iran’s youth volleyball squad delivered a crisp, unified military salute on the podium—an iconic gesture of discipline and national pride that cemented their dominance on the global stage. The young champions stood at attention in a powerful display of camaraderie, celebrating their historic victory with a salute that echoed far beyond the court.
